mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname as username, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT p.*, u.nickname as username, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT p.*, u.nickname as username, u.avatar as user_avatar FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts(user_id, title, content, image_url, like_count, comment_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, 0, 0, 1, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
